lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Quick survival lesson. Read fast, cook faster, and try not to become garnish.

lines.speaker: Controls
lines.text: Move with W, A, S, and D.

lines.speaker: Controls
lines.text: Press E to talk to villagers, pick up ingredients, and use cooking stations.

lines.speaker: Controls
lines.text: Press Space to continue these guide popups.

lines.speaker: Controls
lines.text: Left Click toggles your flashlight. Useful for seeing trouble before it sees you.

lines.speaker: Objective
lines.text: Talk to villagers, collect the requested ingredients, cook at the correct stations, then serve the creature before the countdown reaches zero.

lines.speaker: Warning
lines.text: Correct dishes buy time. Wrong dishes buy awkward silence, then possibly chewing.
